questions.stem_text: According to Davis (1995), women may seek cosmetic surgery because:

options.A: they have a deep-rooted sense of ineffectiveness and are striving for control
options.B: they are in pursuit of the 'perfect' body, fuelled by images of beauty
options.C: they perceive a part of their body as stigmatizing, in relation to a cultural ideal
options.D: their male partners pressurize them to look like supermodels

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - they perceive a part of their body as stigmatizing, in relation to a cultural ideal

questions.stem_text: Post-Fordist forms of media production and consumption involve:

options.A: the mass production of standardized products for passive audiences
options.B: television based on producer-broadcaster rather than publisher-broadcaster models
options.C: a diverse range of products aimed at niche markets
options.D: increasing numbers of advertisements for motoring and car-related products

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - a diverse range of products aimed at niche markets

questions.stem_text: The Nation of Islam group appealed to:

options.A: British-born second generation immigrants from the Asian subcontinent
options.B: White Americans who wanted to convert to Islam
options.C: African-Americans who felt excluded from the 'ethnic melting pot' in the USA
options.D: African-Caribbeans who lived in the inner cities and had a distinctive youth culture

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - African-Americans who felt excluded from the 'ethnic melting pot' in the USA

questions.stem_text: The 'third age' of the life course is said to involve:

options.A: active non-work and independence after retirement
options.B: full time employment, family-building and adult responsibility
options.C: illness, isolation and increasing dependence on others
options.D: the transition from education to work, and distinctive youth cultures

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - active non-work and independence after retirement
